name: The battle language button immediately follows sound and toggles without changing the selected play
Chinese and English card names work in the catalogue in either UI language, including case and spaces
Deck management accepts both names in either language without changing the deck
English ability keywords find matching collected cards in both search modules in either language
English searches never reveal locked cards or offer an Add button for them
Sound and language stay visible and clickable across phone and desktop battle headers
Language preference and canonical battle progress survive reload
